stories.title: Lakers taught important playoff lesson by Spurs: Co-stars matter
stories.summary: The NBA's two main characters met in a fierce contest that was still in doubt until the final buzzer sounded.

stories.title: Pope booed off floor at Rupp as Wichita State shocks 4-3 Kentucky
stories.summary: Kentucky coach Mark Pope was realistic about his struggling Wildcats on Friday, telling reporters that "we clearly have areas where we need to get better," after his team lost to Wichita State, 73-71, in overtime at Rupp Arena, a second consecutive loss.

stories.title: Luka shoved by fan after tossing wristband into stands following Lakers' loss
stories.summary: Lakers star Luka Doncic was shoved by a fan following Friday's loss to the Spurs in a brief altercation that he chalked up as a postgame ritual gone awry.

stories.title: Steelers, fueled by jabs over Rodgers drama, 'come together' to rout Broncos
stories.summary: Turned into a national punchline following Aaron Rodgers' release, the Steelers played with a sense of "urgency" and "anger" Friday night in a 27-5 win over Denver.

stories.title: Texas 'not perfect' but finds way again at A&M, earns SEC title shot vs. UGA
stories.summary: Flaws and all, Texas grinded out its fifth win this season by 10 points or fewer, beating Texas A&M 16-6 on Friday night to reach the SEC title game against Georgia.
